name: PanelComposer

name: planProjectMove
reason: Validates a project move (target team, tags, started, imported issue, issue in flight) and computes its column slot and issue plan; inlining would put five early exits and the self-issue branching into the middle of updateTodo's patch flow.

name: scheduleMovedIssueClose
reason: Fire-and-forget GitHub close of the old self-created issue after a move; inlining would put an async token lookup and its error logging inside the synchronous updateTodo.

name: createdTodoIdOf
